description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeAllowedSkillAPI' that serves as an API endpoint for listing the allowed skills for a specific employee in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving data with pagination and sorting, and integrates with the employee skill service to fetch skill data based on request parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillAPI
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint to list allowed skills for a specific employee, supporting pagination and sorting, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of allowed skills for a given employee, applying sorting and pagination based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method query parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the employee number parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; creation of new resources is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; creation validation is not applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; deletion of resources is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception; delete validation is not applicable.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeSkillService instance.
